doctrine: never discard lane until develop opt budget exhausted

xcom_ideas.rule: H4/Daily trend first; trade only with bias (H4 close>EMA200 or H4 EMA stack); forbid counter-trend entries
Enter on retrace into support / EMA20/50 / prior RBS after breakout; avoid FOMO at extremes
Optional be_at_r=1.0: move SL to entry after +1R
max_entries_per_day=1..2; cooldown tied to calendar day not just bars
risk_pct≈0.01 fixed fraction; ATR-based sizing (turtle N-style)
Keep atr_pctile gates; optional failed-breakout fade only when atr_pctile low
Donchian entry only if close outside prior channel AND distance from mid-channel > k*ATR
Optional session filter: London/NY hours (broker-server mapped); skip pure Asia for XAU H1
Do not encode discrete call levels or signal-service posts; structural rules only
